models: frozen v0.1, v0.3, v0.4; no fitting or threshold tuning
analysis_unit: unique molecular entity within one endpoint/source layer; inhibitor/concentration arms are not independent test compounds
strict_ADC_transport: source-specific human ABCB1 direct bidirectional transport plus matched inhibitor/parental evidence and resolved chemical identity; low ER alone with poor permeability/mixture is exploratory
parent_release_comparison: Only exact chemically changed parents and actual released species measured in same source/system/concentration with controls can supply a measured paired transport change; otherwise delta truth null. Identical free/released chemistry is control, not changed pair.
matched_coverage: simple primary/direct absolute distance from 0.5, stable entity_id tie break; compare accepted counts equal to full selector k. If absent positive or negative in selected population BAcc and NPV null.
secondary_top1: Three known TOP1 species in same published Table S5, separately analyze reported P-gp-arm ER, directional Papp, inhibitor response, and descriptive pair ordering of frozen scores; n=3 purposive source not accuracy or inferential CI. ABCG2 arms separate.
dual_payload: separate components and completeness/identity only, no combined risk probability, synergy or ratio optimization
new_sources: primary sources with documented access and material mapping; new abstract-only evidence remains separate exploratory level
missing_truth: retain explicit not_evaluable and stopping/continuation reason; no synthetic biological outcomes
